title: Motorcycle Enthusiast
paragraphs: “Gua?”
She’s tilting her little head as if to say, “What?”
“Guaa?”
I can tell from the way she’s talking that she’s asking, “Is the race settled?” After spending so many years playing with the Filolial-sama, I’ve come to understand what they’re trying to say.
“There’s someone who wants you. So it’s not about the race…”
“Gua! Gua-gua-gua!”

“No! The race! I want to prove that this White Swan is the fastest!” the White Swan cries out desperately. It seems she’s trying to say she doesn’t want to start molting before the race. Don’t worry, it’ll be fine.
“Gwaa! Gwaa-aa!”

If you want White Swan to lay eggs, bring a male who’s faster than her! Human! White Swan won’t obey anyone unless they’re faster than her! “I won’t obey a jockey riding a horse slower than the White Swan!” it’s also calling out. As if to emphasize this, it started pecking at the caretaker with its beak.
“Ow, ow, ow!”
“Guaaaaaa!”

“Raceeeee!” White Swan is calling out “Race!” Oh… I’d only ever known White Swan after she’d lost a race, so I didn’t realize it, but she really is such a stoic horse. This is another side of Yuki-chan… It’s a surprise, much like the difference between her and Sakura-chan and Filo-tan.
“She’s on the verge of becoming a wild Filolial… a hot-tempered thoroughbred.”
“Her speed is second to none, Master. She’s the one we’re counting on for next season, and we were in the middle of training her.”
“As for her race debut… depending on how quickly her level rises, it’ll probably be in about a month.”
“Yes. However… due to the economic downturn, the number of races has decreased, so we’re currently struggling to decide what to do.”

Come to think of it, the reason she came to my Father’s place was because of the speed of Filo-tan and the Filolials I’d raised. The breeder was just one of countless owners, and the person who came to my Father’s place to pitch a bet was someone else entirely.
“White Swan! I’m the one who wants you!”
At this point, I step forward abruptly and introduce myself.
“Gua!?”
White Swan glares at me—it seems she’s taken me for an enemy.
“Guaaaaah!”
“Do you have what it takes to ride White Swan’s back? Let’s settle this!” White Swan’s eyes are blazing with intensity! Oh… Yuki-chan, you’re so brave. I suppose I should be the one to take her on!
“I’ll be your opponent! If I win, you’ll come with me!”
“Gwaaaaah!”
“Bring it on!” the White Swan replies.
“Spear Hero… I think that’s a good way to win over the White Swan. So, we’ll choose a Filolial who can beat this one, and we’d like you to ride her.”
“No need to worry. In fact, White Swan wouldn’t be truly satisfied with that… I’ll face him myself!”
“Huh? Um… Spear Hero? No matter what, it’s going to be incredibly tough for a human to keep up with a Filolial with racing feathers, even with the level difference…”
“It’ll be fine… I’m doing this for White Swan’s sake. I’ll give it my all, too!”
I step onto the grass racetrack where White Swan is waiting and take my place at the starting line.
“Motoyasu, Drive Mode!”
I switch my spear to the wheeled version and enter Drive Mode.
“W-Wait, the Spear Hero!?”
“What the hell is that!? Are you kidding me!?”
“G, Gaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!”
“Don’t underestimate me! You humannnnnnnn!” White Swan lets out a loud cry.
“Oh? Are you running away? I’m just playing along with you, you know?”
“Gua!”
Taking my taunt as a challenge, the White Swan stands at the starting line, radiating a murderous aura, as if to show me the difference in our abilities.
“It’s a full-speed, one-lap race with no riders!”
“Gwaaaaah!”
“Now, please give the signal to start the race.”
“Are you sure you’re serious!?”
The hermit lets out a cry of surprise, but I nod repeatedly.
“Um… Well then, let’s begin today’s race…”
The breeder holds the flag and gets ready to start. For some reason, his voice sounds a bit lackluster.
“Guaaaaah…”

Either way, I can feel White Swan’s enthusiasm—she’s thrilled just to be racing. She has such a lively expression. Come to think of it, Yuki-chan always loved racing. At her core, she hasn’t changed a bit.
The moment the producer swings the flag down, White Swan makes a flying start. She dashes off, “Dada-dada!”
I’m going for it too! Vroom, vroom! With a screech of the wheels, I take off as well!
“Vroom, vroom!”
Kicking up a cloud of dust, I race alongside White Swan.
“Gwaaaah!?”

What!? Are you actually catching up to White Swan’s legs in such a ridiculous stance!? White Swan looks completely taken aback. Does she even have time to look away? Too bad—she’s nowhere near as fast as a serious Filo-tan! I’ll just keep picking up speed.
“…He’s easily catching up to White Swan in that ridiculous pose… Spear Hero, who exactly are you…?”
“Is that guy even human…?”

The Immortal and the Producer let out stunned exclamations, but right now, winning this race against the White Swan is what matters most! With a screech, I take the corner while drifting! A light acceleration leads to a stable drive. I keep going, jumping over obstacles with wheelies and steadily pulling further and further ahead of White Swan.
“Guaaaaaaaaaaah!”
“I won’t loseeeeeee!” White Swan races on with all the strength it can muster, but I can’t afford to lose, so I just keep going. Eventually, I crossed the finish line at the end of the circuit.
“I’m the winner!”
A victory pose while doing a wheelie! The White Swan put up a good fight, but it’s still got a ways to go.
“Master… what was that all about?”
“Hmm… his love for Filolial is undeniable… but the world is full of things that run deep.”
“I don’t think that’s the kind of story we’re talking about here…”
“Gua… Gua… Gua…”
Panting heavily, White Swan came over.
“So I win, then!”
“Gua…”
White Swan, who had been sitting on the ground, nodded in acknowledgment of his defeat.
“Guaa…”
Then White Swan gave me a passionate look. That’s definitely Yuki-chan’s look!
“Well then, White Swan, from now on, you’re my Filolial-sama!”
“Gua!”
“Gua…”
“Guaa…”

The Filolial-sama—my racing buddies who seemed to harbor secret feelings for White Swan—are letting out wistful cries. I do feel a bit torn, but since Yuki-chan asked me to do this in another loop, there’s nothing I can do about it.
“Gua!”
White Swan nuzzled up close to me. It reminds me of Yuki-chan in her Filolial form. So I’ll pet her, too. And just like that, I succeeded in earning White Swan’s trust.
“Ah… I see. With this method, the White Swan really has no choice but to obey.”
“Regardless of the means, I take my hat off to the Spear Hero’s wisdom and his actions that respect the will of the Filolials…”
And so, I became the master of the White Swan.
“As for what’s next… I’d like to raise many Filolial-samas on Cal Mira Island… though, since I’m busy, it’d be best to raise a Filolial-sama who can assist me first.”

I’ve asked Fleon-chan and Black Thunder to keep an eye on Itsuki and Ren. It would be an option to ask my Father for help here, but I’m still a bit worried about how strong he and the others are. If Big Sister were here, I’m sure they’d get strong right away, but either way, there’s a lot I need to take care of.

I’m pretty busy myself with Rival’s orders and all that. If I ignore them, it’ll just lead to more trouble. In fact, just as Rival said, when I unleashed a Brionac on the Spirit Tortoise’s Cave at the appointed time, the Spirit Tortoise didn’t revive. Of course, Rival did say that doesn’t mean there aren’t still people trying to break the seal afterward. He seems to be good at fine-tuning these kinds of details.
“Gua!”
White Swan lets out a cry right here. I’m sure White Swan—who is actually Yuki-chan—will act exactly as I expect her to.
“So first, we’ll raise White Swan and Kou. After that, we’ll get serious about training Filolial-sama and the others.”
“I’ve already spoken to them. My disciples should be flexible enough to accommodate us to some extent.”

I’m grateful for the Immortal’s cooperation. After all, it’s important to approach everything with sincerity. If you’re sincere, the number of people who become your allies will naturally increase. Oh? The version of my future Father in my head is rolling his eyes, thinking, “Who on earth is thinking that…?” but… it’ll be fine!
“Well then, let’s go!”
“Guaa!”

I headed to the port bound for Cal Mira Island with the Immortal and White Swan. As for the ship, we managed to board the next departure after the one taken by my future Father and the others. The sea was rough, but the voyage seemed to be going smoothly.
“Yuki—White Swan, just a little more patience.”
“Gua.”

Little by little, White Swan’s appearance is starting to resemble that of the Queen. However, perhaps because she hasn’t leveled up yet, the transformation is slow. We’ll have to level her up as soon as we arrive at Cal Mira Island.
“She’s quick to move on, isn’t she…? It must be an instinct born of the pursuit of speed.”

The sage analyzes as he strokes White Swan. The ability to accept defeat and obediently follow the victor… that’s the mindset that says strength is everything. It’s fundamentally different from those reincarnated folk. Those lot, when they lose, end up escaping reality and resorting to underhanded tactics. Just like Takt! They demand obedience because they won, yet refuse to comply even when they lose.
However, White Swan obediently follows my lead whenever she loses. This is the very essence of sincerity in one who pursues strength.
“Guaa…”
“Her fiery temper has subsided… I look forward to her future.”
“Of course, in the future, I’ll let her compete in the Filolial Race.”
“Gua!”
White Swan’s eyes are shining as brightly as can be. She must be discovering her own untapped potential.
“But… that’s true. The other Filolial-samas might be disappointed if they’re too slow.”
I was struck by how Yuki-chan sighed when she saw how slow the other Filolial-samas were during the race. I suppose it must be lonely not to have any rivals to compete against.
“The Filolials are undergoing a transformation like Fleon’s… For those involved with the Filolials, being part of this phenomenon must be a joy beyond compare… It’s the dawn of a new era, isn’t it?”
“Sage, I’m going to save you, too.”

Since we never met in the first world, I don’t know what kind of life the Sage led there. That’s precisely why, now that I’ve come to know the Immortal, I want from the bottom of my heart to give him a satisfying outcome. And so, we arrived at Cal Mira Island.
“Peep!”
Kou hatched just as we arrived on the island that morning. It was a morning after we’d weathered the rough seas.
“We’ve arrived!”
When I stepped off the ship, my Father and the others were just about to set out for the hunting grounds.
“Hm? Oh, Motoyasu’s here too… Wait, those guys… weren’t they the former owners of that Fleon fellow?”
“That’s right! They’re known as the Filolial Sages!”
“Well… that’s just a nickname the Spear Hero came up with on his own…”
“Oh, I see. You’ve got your hands full, don’t you?”
“Oh my—”
“Hmm?”
Eek… Filo-tan is here, too. Oh? There’s a tuft of hair—Filo-tan’s signature feature—on her head. I looked at that tuft and then at Father, who sighed deeply and nodded.
“It was on the night of the boat ride here. Just like you said, a huge Filolial showed up. So, it challenged Filo and Fleon to a duel. After fighting for a bit, it gave them a feather.”
“What happened to Black Thunder?”
“It suddenly lunged at it, got kicked, and got scolded. It didn’t get a feather.”
I can’t believe it… Black Thunder wasn’t granted the trial from the great Filolial-sama. Ren and Itsuki must have been down from seasickness.
“A giant Filolial…?”
“Ah, apparently it went by the name Fitoria. That’s what the Filo folk were saying, anyway.”
“Goodness! To actually encounter a legendary Filolial…! How enviable!　I’m sure Her Majesty the Queen of Melromarc would have wanted to meet her as well.”
“She seemed like a bit of a carefree sort, though.”
“She’s Filolial-sama, after all. I would have liked to meet her, too.”
Unfortunately, my Father often blinds me with a blindfold or something, so it’s hard for me to see her. She’s the kind of person who’s gone before you even realize it.
